import getpass, json, os, secrets, sys, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request

from daemon import Blocked, call, open_db, persist

BOT="Neur0Store_bot"
CURATOR_URL="https://chatgpt.com/c/6ac7068e-883c-83ed-9081-cb94557e61bd"
CURATOR_BRANCH="agent/telegram-curator-authority-20261012"
CURATOR_SHA="773b42f59018a2e55834b87275796486d686e4f6"
CURATOR_ID="tg-curator-owner"
BRIDGE="http://127.0.0.1:17448"

def telegram(token,method,params=None,timeout=10):
    url="https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/"+method
    result=call(url,params,timeout)
    if not result.get("ok"): raise Blocked("telegram_"+method+"_failed")
    return result["result"]

def eligible_profile():
    """Find the one existing Chrome profile with the existing curator tab."""
    meta=call(BRIDGE+"/api/ai-profiles",timeout=6)
    found=[]
    for p in meta.get("aiProfiles",[]):
        if p.get("provider")!="chatgpt" or p.get("enabled") is False: continue
        port=int(p.get("debugPort") or 0)
        if port<1024:continue
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:"+str(port)+"/json/list",timeout=4) as f:
                tabs=json.load(f)
        except (OSError, ValueError):continue
        matching=[t for t in tabs if t.get("type")=="page" and t.get("url","").rstrip("/")==CURATOR_URL]
        if len(matching)==1:found.append(p)
        elif len(matching)>1:raise Blocked("duplicate_curator_tabs")
    if len(found)!=1:raise Blocked("curator_existing_profile_not_unique")
    return found[0]

def register_readback():
    """Only show registered state. Do not modify other agents or auto enable watchdog."""
    managed=call(BRIDGE+"/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats",timeout=8)
    matching=[r for r in managed.get("chats",[]) if r.get("url")==CURATOR_URL]
    if not matching:return "not_registered"
    if len(matching)!=1:raise Blocked("curator_duplicate_registration")
    rec=matching[0]
    if rec.get("id")!=CURATOR_ID or rec.get("repository")!="foto6/boss" or rec.get("branch")!=CURATOR_BRANCH:
        raise Blocked("curator_registration_conflict")
    return "registered"

def enroll(token):
    info=telegram(token,"getMe",None,10)
    if str(info.get("username","")).casefold()!=BOT.casefold():
        raise Blocked("wrong_bot_identity")
    hook=telegram(token,"getWebhookInfo",None,10)
    if (hook.get("url") or "").strip():
        raise Blocked("existing_webhook_do_not_override")
    code=secrets.token_hex(4).upper()
    print("Open https://t.me/"+BOT+" and send exactly: /start "+code)
    print("Pairing requires a fresh PRIVATE message in this one bot.")
    deadline=time.monotonic()+150
    offset=None
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        data={"timeout":5,"limit":50,"allowed_updates":["message"]}
        if offset is not None:data["offset"]=offset

                return {"userid":sender["id"],"chatid":chat["id"],"offset":offset or uid+1}
        time.sleep(0.2)
    raise Blocked("pairing_timeout_no_matching_private_message")

def main():

    print("First revoke the old published token in @BotFather: /revoke.")
    print("Do not paste the new token into any chat, issue or URL.")

    if confirm!="ROTATED":raise Blocked("rotation_not_confirmed")
    profile=eligible_profile()
    state=register_readback()
    if state=="not_registered":
        print("Curator is not yet registered with WebAIBridge. Pairing can proceed, but dispatcher remains blocked until registered.")
    from telegram_transport import parse_proxy, ProxyTransportError
    print("TGWS MTProto port 1443 cannot carry HTTPS Bot API directly.")
    print("Optional HTTPS Bot API proxy: HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5h, e.g. socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080")
    print("Press Enter for direct connection. Proxy address input is hidden.")
    proxy=getpass.getpass("HTTP/SOCKS5h proxy URL (hidden, optional): ").strip()
    try:
        parse_proxy(proxy)
    except ProxyTransportError as e:
        raise Blocked("invalid_telegram_proxy_"+str(e)) from None
    if proxy:
        os.environ["CURATOR_TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL"]=proxy
    token=getpass.getpass("Enter NEW BotFather token here (hidden locally): ").strip()
    if not token or ":" not in token:raise Blocked("token_format_invalid")
    pairing=enroll(token)
    base={
      "CURATOR_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN":token,
      "CURATOR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID":str(pairing["chatid"]),
      "CURATOR_TELEGRAM_USER_ID":str(pairing["userid"]),
      "CURATOR_MANAGED_CHAT_ID":CURATOR_ID,
      "CURATOR_CHAT_URL":CURATOR_URL,
      "CURATOR_REPOSITORY":"foto6/boss",
      "CURATOR_BRANCH":CURATOR_BRANCH,
      "CURATOR_EXPECTED_HEAD":CURATOR_SHA,
      "CURATOR_BRIDGE_URL":BRIDGE,
      "CURATOR_TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL":proxy
    }
    dest=write(base)
    # The /start update is already processed. Persist offset to avoid replay on first daemon start.
    d=open_db({"db":str(dest.parent/"inbox.sqlite3")})
    try:
        with d:
            d.execute("INSERT INTO meta(k,v) VALUES('offset',?) ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v",
                      (str(pairing["offset"]),))
    finally:d.close()
    print("Encrypted private DPAPI credentials created in LOCALAPPDATA.")
    print("Sender and private chat paired. Secret was not printed or committed.")
    print("Exact ChatGPT curator registration status: "+state)
    print("Use CHECK_CURATOR.cmd to test binding. Start only after it reports CONFIG_OK.")

if __name__=="__main__":
    try:main()
    except (Blocked,SecretError) as exc:
        print("SETUP_BLOCKED:"+str(exc),file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(2)
